name: Build macOS arm64 binary

on:
  release:
    types: [published]

permissions:
  contents: write

jobs:
  build-macos:
    runs-on: macos-14
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install -r requirements.txt
          pip install pyinstaller

      - name: Build PyInstaller binary
        run: |
          pyinstaller --onefile --distpath dist --name a2a-scanner a2a_scanner.py

      - name: Create tar.gz archive
        run: |
          TAG=${{ github.ref_name }}
          tar -czf a2a-scanner-${TAG}-arm64.tar.gz -C dist a2a-scanner
